feature.label: TestSmellDetector
feature.description: Detects test smells in Java unit tests from inside Eclipse. Select a Java project and run the detector to see bad practices in your test code — assertion roulette, magic numbers, sleepy tests, eager tests, and others — reported in a dedicated results view.
